title: Model spell-selection class feature choices
description:
Problem:
Some higher-level class features require choosing spells, but those choices are not represented as deterministic spell filters.

Examples:
- feature:bard:magical-secrets
- feature:college-of-lore:additional-magical-secrets
- feature:wizard:spell-mastery
- feature:wizard:signature-spells

Implement:
- Add schema support for spell-choice filters where needed.
- Represent constraints such as count, spell level, class list restriction or lack of restriction, and known/prepared relationship according to SRD text.
- Link these choices from the relevant feature records.
- Keep selected spells stored by spell record id.

Acceptance criteria:
- A deterministic character builder can ask for legal Magical Secrets choices.
- A deterministic character builder can ask for legal Spell Mastery and Signature Spells choices.
- Constraints are source-derived and tested.
- The choice-bearing prose audit no longer flags these records.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
close_reason: Implemented structured spell filters for Magical Secrets, Spell Mastery, Signature Spells, and Warlock option spell choices
